desc: Parse the input N, M and the M edges; build adjacency lists for the graph.
Find all connected components with BFS/DFS; compute component sizes, bipartition side parity, and K (number of odd components), P (parity of one side over even components).
Brute-force minimax solver for small N over bipartite graphs, cross-checked against the candidate formula.
Derive the winning condition: N odd -> Aoki iff M odd; N even, K=0 -> Aoki iff (P+M) odd; N even, K=2 -> Aoki; N even, K>=4 -> Aoki iff M odd.
Implement the final O(N+M) algorithm (iterative BFS) and print `Aoki` or `Takahashi`.
Verify on all three samples (all PASSED) plus edge cases (N=1, N=2, M=0, multi-component, complete bipartite).
